rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when someone is believed to be controlled by an evil spirit.

example.english: They suddenly became possessed last night and yelled at everyone at home.
example.traditional: 佢尋晚突然鬼上身，喺屋企亂咁鬧人。
example.jyutping: keoi5 cam4 maan5 dat6 jin4 gwai2 soeng5 san1 hai2 uk1 kei2 lyun6 gam3 naau6 jan2

rows.note: Use this when a powerful emotion such as anger or jealousy overwhelms someone's judgment.

example.english: I was possessed by jealousy for a moment and said some hurtful things.
example.traditional: 我一時俾妒忌沖昏頭腦，亂咁講咗啲難聽說話。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 si4 bei2 dou3 gei6 cung1 fan1 tau4 nou5 lyun6 gam3 gong2 zo2 di1 naan4 teng1 syut3 waa6
